description: Apply Premium AI Terminal design consistency across all remaining pages (Matches, Predictions, MatchDetail, Analytics, EasyMatches, Settings) and supporting components (MarketRow, StatisticsComparison, FormDisplay, HeadToHead, etc.). Ensure entire application feels like one cohesive premium football intelligence system with dark glass surfaces, blue/purple highlights, restrained glow, and compact professional spacing. This is a batch update applying the same visual pattern established in FEAT-001-003 to all remaining UI surfaces.
steps: 1. Read frontend/src/pages/Matches.css - matches listing page styles
2. Update Matches.css: Apply dark glass cards (rgba(26, 26, 36, 0.7)), blue borders (rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2)), blue hover glow, ensure match cards follow same visual language as Dashboard cards
3. Read frontend/src/pages/Predictions.css - predictions page styles
4. Update Predictions.css: Apply consistent dark glass surfaces, blue accent highlights, ensure prediction display components align with redesigned MensionePickCard aesthetic
5. Read frontend/src/pages/MatchDetail.css - match detail page styles

6. Update MatchDetail.css: Apply dark glass panels for analysis sections, blue/purple borders on stat panels, ensure page header follows Dashboard title pattern (blue→purple gradient if prominent heading exists), maintain readability of statistics with proper contrast
7. Read frontend/src/components/match/StatisticsComparison.css, FormDisplay.css, HeadToHead.css, FirstHalfAnalysis.css, FullMatchAnalysis.css, GeneralAnalysis.css

8. Update all match analysis component CSS files (batch operation - same pattern for all): (a) Dark glass backgrounds: rgba(26, 26, 36, 0.7) or rgba(26, 26, 36, 0.6) for layered sections, (b) Blue accent borders: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2) for panels, (c) Update any green highlights to blue where appropriate (preserve semantic green for success/positive indicators), (d) Ensure stat displays remain readable with proper text contrast, (e) Update section headings to use blue/purple accents, (f) Maintain compact spacing and professional data presentation
9. Read frontend/src/components/predictions/MarketRow.css - market odds display component
10. Update MarketRow.css: Apply dark glass row backgrounds, blue hover states, ensure odds values clearly visible, align visual style with card interiors
11. Read frontend/src/components/combine/CombinePanel.css and CombineDrawer.css - combine/accumulator UI

12. Update CombinePanel.css and CombineDrawer.css: Dark glass backgrounds, blue borders, blue accent for selected items, ensure panel follows same premium aesthetic, combine CTA button should match Dashboard combine button styling (blue theme)
13. Read frontend/src/components/track-record/PerformanceOverview.css - performance tracking UI
14. Update PerformanceOverview.css: Dark glass cards, blue borders, stat displays with blue highlights, ensure data visualization remains clear and readable
15. Read frontend/src/pages/Analytics.tsx to check if custom CSS file exists (Analytics.css)
16. If Analytics.css exists, update it with consistent dark glass + blue accent pattern; if no custom CSS, verify Analytics page inherits global styles correctly
17. Read frontend/src/pages/EasyMatches.tsx to check if custom CSS exists
18. If EasyMatches has custom CSS, apply consistent styling; ensure easy match indicators use appropriate color coding (preserve semantic colors for difficulty/confidence)
19. Read frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx and frontend/src/pages/pages.css (shared page styles)
20. Update Settings page styling if custom CSS exists: dark glass form elements, blue focus states, clean toggle switches, professional input fields
21. Update pages.css if it exists with shared page-level patterns: dark glass containers, blue section dividers, consistent heading styles
22. Read frontend/src/components/common/ component CSS files (StatusBadge, ProbabilityDisplay, ConfidenceIndicator, ValueIndicator may have associated CSS)

23. Update any common component CSS: ensure badges use appropriate semantic colors (keep success=green, error=red, warning=yellow) but apply new dark backgrounds and blue neutral states where appropriate
24. Final verification pass: visit ALL pages in browser (Ana Sayfa, Canlı, Maçlar, Tahminler, Easy Match, Analiz, Ayarlar) and verify consistent visual language across entire application
25. Check for any remaining green theme artifacts that should be blue/purple (except semantic success states and MENSIONE brand green in active nav)
26. Verify all interactive states (hover, focus, active) use blue theme consistently
27. Ensure all text maintains proper contrast ratios for readability (WCAG AA minimum)
28. Verify responsive layouts still work correctly on mobile/tablet after CSS changes
